_why: Buys the five fire talents the premade build reaches none or half of,
all of them the Alonecraft redesign rather than retail's tree:
Firebreak 3/3        Fire Blast deals 20% more damage per Ember Scars
stack and clears one. This is what the woa fire
rotation is built on; without it Fire Blast stays
a movement filler and the rotation is the stock one.
Cleansing Flame 2/2  Fire spells heal for 50% of their damage under
Molten Armor, and fire crits clear Ember Scars at
double rate. The premade build reaches 1/2.
Fiery Payback 2/2    Damage taken below 35% health cut by 25%.
Improved Fire Blast 2/2  Fire Blast is a rotational button now, so its
cooldown is throughput rather than convenience.
Master of Elements 3/3  Was 2/3. Crit mana return is the fire sustain
plan, and the sustain pass is where it shows.
Funded by talents that need someone else, or somewhere else, to be worth
anything:
Focus Magic          gives a party member crit and pays back only when
they crit. Worth exactly nothing alone.
Blast Wave, Dragon's Breath, Firestarter  the AoE cone package: both
cones are melee-range on a ranged spec, and
Firestarter exists only to let them be cast while
moving. 4 points.
Torment the Weak 3/3 only applies to snared or slowed targets, which a
fire mage has no way to produce.
Student of the Mind  1 point of spirit, and dropping it with Focus
Magic is what takes the arcane tree down to a
13-point clean stop below row 3.
13 Arcane / 58 Fire.
